text:
Sam: ACME POC ask: committed baseline + burst plan, preheat run, BYOK and EU-only. Need numbers and one-line SOW items.
Olivia: Quick profile: steady 220 qps, 30% peak to 640 qps, avg seq ~110 tokens, p95 target <250ms.
Marta: Recommend start: 6 reserved high-throughput slots, autoscale to 13 for bursts. That covers steady plus buffering for spikes with batching.
Sam: How long to preheat KV/prefix cache? They said top 1k prefixes are hot.
Marta: Plan a 75 min preheat for top-1k + progressive fill. Expect ~4% extra token usage.
Sam: Procurement wants preheat fee example.
Olivia: SOW line: "One-time preheat: 6 slots x 1.25h x hourly-rate = est. $YYY (billed actuals if exceeded)." Note: synthetic/scrubbed data only.
Sam: Data residency and KMS?
security-bot: BYOK supported on Enterprise/Private. EU-only region provisioning available; logs retention configurable to 12 months.
Sam: Bath of fallback options for saturation?
Marta: Two-tier fallback: (1) quantized model on same pool for degraded quality, (2) short-context model on spot capacity. Configure hedged routing + rate-limits.
Sam: Paste a tiny autoscale snippet we can include.
Marta: ```yaml
autoscale:
  min: 6
  max: 13
  qps_per_replica: 45
  prewarm_minutes: 75
```
infra-bot: `rbctl reservations check --region eu-central --type reserved --count 6` -> est lead time 4 business days; 2 vendor slots available now.
Olivia: Billing options: reserved monthly + (A) burst credits included up to X% or (B) on-demand overage per-minute. Recommend adding 10-12% burst-credit line for POC.
Sam: I'll draft the SOW lines and share. Marta/open infra ticket for eu pool. Olivia prepare quote options. Security will attach compliance docs.
Marta: Opening infra ticket now and tagging @infra.
Sam: Thanks team. Closing until ACME responds. :thumbsup:
